Enable Code (Must Be On)|1,16,FFFFFF,8C5FF000;1,16,12D7A,C0705040
These codes don't work on any cheat device besides Xploder DC, Code Breaker DC, or X-Terminator DC (Japan only). To try to stop cheating, Sonic Team deletes the memory that cheat devices normally use. It is impossible to crack this, because there are at least 150 places in the game that it verifies that that area really is clear. The only option is to change the place that the cheat device installs itself. The competitors to Xploder DC don't have a way to do that. Xploder DC does, and we had to use it in the US Version 2. (The Japanese Version 2 did not take Xploder into account, and therefore didn't need this "move" code.)-Saved Time Modifier|1,16,1810E6,D301;1,32,1810E8,9A002;1,16,1810F0,6402
